entities.summary: Gregory Reid Wiseman is an American astronaut and naval aviator. He is presently the commander of the 2026 Artemis II lunar flyby mission, the first crewed flight around the Moon since Apollo 17 in 1972. He served as the 17th chief of the Astronaut Office until November 14, 2022.
